entries.scope: Least-privilege homogeneity CI and shared CodeQL source/consumer assessment
entries.rationale: Explicit read-only workflow authority prevents inheritance of the live write-enabled repository default. Re-evaluation: the workflow and evidence are source-only, but the regression under scripts/tests is included by the Home Runtime manifest; its sync is covered by the current preset delivery.
readerPaths: SECURITY.md -> shared maintenance explanation -> exact source PR and CI evidence
entries.navigationImpact: Existing maintenance documentation family; no new top-level product navigation.
entries.languageStrategy: Complete German first, equivalent English second; CEFR B2 and applicable WCAG 2.2 AA criteria.
entries.platformAndExampleProof: Bash and PowerShell documentation validation; exact reporting paragraphs, repository URLs, UTF-8, languages and headings. GitHub rendering checked at delivery; no new VoiceOver, NVDA or Braille acceptance claimed. Regenerated script reference from the unchanged canonical catalog after the regression source changed; renderer CheckOnly reports CURRENT.
entries.risk: Static triage does not prove runtime exploitability; unresolved boundaries remain needs_review. No alert dismissal or new accepted risk.
entries.reevaluationTrigger: Workflow permission overrides, changed callers, package versions, source binding or rollout drift.
